acceptanceCriteria: Reproduction in script/spec-requirements-conflict_test.sh for two-appends-one-section and two-new-specs, merged both ways
Either both cases merge cleanly with regenerated files byte-equal to a fresh generation, or a documented one-command regenerate resolution exists and is tested
SRG spec limit text updated to match
body: Residual of V1-1525 (PR #1108, SRG-V0-016 recorded limit). After REQUIREMENTS.tsv dropped its line column, cross-section edits to one spec merge cleanly, but two branches that append requirements to the same spec section, or that each add a new spec (appending to docs/specs/INDEX.json and docs/specs/README.md), still produce textual conflicts on adjacent rows. Expected: independent additions merge cleanly or regenerate deterministically. Actual: same conflict as before #1108. Evidence: script/spec-requirements-conflict_test.sh limit table in PR #1108. Related but distinct: V1-0725 (INDEX.json re-escaping on merge). Candidate fixes: confirm INDEX.json/README.md are sorted by spec path and pad ordering keys; or document regenerate-on-conflict as the resolution with a script.
